summary.t: A set of 12 decorative baubles with personalised messages corresponding to the 12 Christmas wishes.

text.t:
More than just simple decorations, these are 12 wishes filled with love, hope and magic to light up Christmas.
Each ball, made of white lacquered MDF and delicately cut, holds a special message to remind us of what truly matters: love, family, friendship, peace, joy, harmony, faith, love, and the passion of being together.
A set created with care to decorate your Christmas tree and fill every home with tenderness, togetherness and unforgettable moments.
The set of 12 is sold together, with the Santa Claus ball with sleigh and reindeer included as a gift and engraved with your chosen text (the family name or "Merry Christmas"), or you can buy each ball individually.

options.escolha.values.conjunto.name.t: Set of 12, with the sleigh ball included

options.family.help.t: It is engraved on the Santa Claus ball with the sleigh and reindeer (in the set of 12, it is the free gift ball). It can be the family name or "Merry Christmas".

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of young children, who may put it in their mouths.
